arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of Growth and Decay at the Tree of Whispers.

Dealing any damage with your skills has a {c_number}[SF_20*100|%|]{/c} chance to grow a flower from the ground. When an enemy is near, the flower deals {c_random}{SF_4}{/c} Poison damage to {if:SF_2}all nearby enemies{else}that enemy{/if} over {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} seconds. If an ally is near, the flower heals{if:SF_2}  all nearby allies{/if} for {c_random}[SF_7*100|1|]%{/c} maximum Life. The flower withers away after use. A flower may grow once every {c_number}[SF_8]{/c} seconds per enemy.
The damage and healing affects all enemies or allies near the flower.
